page_title: HAV 0-0 MON | Le Havre v Monaco 11/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Thomas Leonard is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+9' Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom left corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, allowing Philipp Kohn to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
90+9' Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) is going to take the penalty!
90+8' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90+6' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Edan Diop (Monaco) was quite harsh and Thomas Leonard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+6' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Le Havre!

90+6' Play continues despite the shouts by some Le Havre players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Thomas Leonard interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
90+5' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) meets a cross inside the box, but Arthur Desmas wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
90+5' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Le Havre for a penalty. Play continues.

90+4' A sweet pass finds Folarin Balogun (Monaco) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Arthur Desmas is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
90+2' The Monaco players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
90+1' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Today's match ends for Mohamed Bayo who will be replaced by Andy Logbo (Le Havre).
90' Luka Elsner prepares a substitution. Daler Kuzyaev is replaced by Yassine Kechta (Le Havre).
89' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arthur Desmas intercepts the ball.
87' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) sends a chip pass into the box, but Philipp Kohn is quickest to intercept the ball.
86' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) commits a foul and Thomas Leonard immediately signals a free kick.
83' 37:63 – the latest ball possession ratio.
81' Here comes a substitution. Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) is brought on as a substitute for Abdoulaye Toure.
80' Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
79' Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
78' Monaco hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
76' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches past the right post.
73' Substitution. Wissam Ben Yedder leaves the pitch and is replaced by Folarin Balogun (Monaco).
72' The manager makes a subsitution with Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) coming on for Antoine Joujou.
72' Luka Elsner has decided to substitute Nabil Alioui and he is replaced by Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre).
69' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
68' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Thomas Leonard had an easy-decision to make.
66' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Maghnes Akliouche walks off the pitch to be replaced by Takumi Minamino (Monaco).
64' A corner kick by Monaco is thwarted by the well prepared Arthur Desmas (Le Havre).
61' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball has crossed the sideline. Le Havre are taking a throw-in.
57' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
57' PENALTY APPEAL by Le Havre, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
55' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

53' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the right side of the goal. However, Philipp Kohn anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
50' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Philipp Kohn was alert and made a comfortable save.
48' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
46' Adi Hutter makes a half-time substitution. Edan Diop (Monaco) comes on in place of Krepin Diatta.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Good movement by Josue Casimir (Le Havre), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
43' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Thomas Leonard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
42' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) but poses no threat.
40' Le Havre keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
37' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
35' It's a throw-in for Le Havre.
31' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
30' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.
27' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) sends a chip pass into the box, but Philipp Kohn is quickest to intercept the ball.
27' Le Havre take a short corner kick.
25' Monaco failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
22' Le Havre couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Philipp Kohn (Monaco) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
21' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
19' The referee blows his whistle as Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) was too aggressive in his challenge.
17' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle after Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
15' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
13' Monaco have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
10' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) has tested the patience of referee Thomas Leonard and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

7' Loic Nego (Le Havre) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
6' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Thomas Leonard signals.
3' Guillermo Maripan (Monaco) dribbles into the box, but Arthur Desmas is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Le Havre will take the kick-off.
Thomas Leonard will referee today's match.
